svg.title: Callback overshoot across three input patterns
svg.desc: Overshoot beyond a 50 ms quiet period, 30 interleaved bursts per input pattern; filled points are medians, hollow points are p95, not uncertainty intervals. One value medians 1.01, 1.04, 1.38 ms and p95 2.07, 2.16, 2.60; 20 at once medians 0.96, 1.18, 1.19 and p95 2.07, 3.32, 1.70; 60 every 5 ms medians 1.02, 0.77, 1.08 and p95 2.03, 1.91, 2.38. Order: task per value, long-lived task, swift-debounce. All panels use the same 0–4 ms scale.
